dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have there been any suspicious happenings lately?

dialogues.speaker: Moce
dialogues.text: Not at present. That said, the barbarians are akin to cunning beasts. Ever will they strike when your guard has been lowered, for surprise is their greatest weapon!

dialogues.speaker: Moce
dialogues.text: By methods most foul they infiltrate our cities and seek out our secrets. Even the slightest lapse in discipline may lead to catastrophe.

dialogues.speaker: Moce
dialogues.text: *sigh* Thirty years ago, when I followed Dominus Boethius to conquest in the far north, they were but a pack of primitives without any such skill for subterfuge. Where did they learn these tricks?
